advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Either consume `cfg.bedrock_model_id` when building the Bedrock model (e.g. default `cfg.model` to `bedrock:{bedrock_model_id}` when the provider is bedrock and no explicit model set) or remove the field, env var, and docs entry so no dead knob remains.
evidence: config.py:633 `bedrock_model_id=_llm_str(table, cli, "REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID", "bedrock_model_id", DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID,)` — the field is populated
`search_files bedrock_model_id` returns ONLY config.py definitions (521/633/637) and no reader anywhere in src/
runner.py:273 `resolved = _pai_model(cfg)` and anthropic_model.py:150-152 `m = cfg.model; if ":" in m: return m` — the model id comes exclusively from `cfg.model`, never `cfg.bedrock_model_id`
ticket AC + operator run both use `REBAR_LLM_MODEL=bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6`, confirming `cfg.model` is the sole entry point
ABSENCE: `cfg.bedrock_region_name` IS threaded through (bedrock_model.py:67) while `cfg.bedrock_model_id` is not — an inconsistent, surprising split
advisory.finding: `REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID` / `cfg.bedrock_model_id` is parsed and documented but never consumed: the runner resolves the model string solely from `cfg.model` (`_pai_model(cfg)`), so setting the env var has no effect on which Bedrock model runs.
scenarios: An operator sets `REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID=us.anthropic.claude-opus-...` expecting to switch models, leaves `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` default, and silently keeps running the default model.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Remove the unused `DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID` from bedrock_model.py (or wire it as the single source and import it where the model id is actually chosen).
evidence: `search_files DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID`: bedrock_model.py:38 defines it; the only importers are config.py's own literal comment and tests/external which import from `rebar.llm.config`, never from `rebar.llm.bedrock_model`

config.py:50-53 comment: "Duplicated as a literal (not imported) from `rebar.llm.bedrock_model.DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID` ... kept in sync by hand" — but the bedrock_model.py copy is referenced by nothing

scenarios: A future model-id bump updates config.py's literal but not bedrock_model.py's, and the divergence is invisible because nothing reads the bedrock_model.py copy.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a case to the translation tests where a wrapper exception carries the sampling-rejection only in its `__cause__`, asserting it still translates to `LLMConfigError`.

scenarios: pydantic-ai/boto3 wraps the ValidationException as the `__cause__` of a generic error, which per the docstring is the common real shape

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the `_model_id_of` fallback-override branch (capabilities.py:220-252) is authorized: Decision C path 3 specifies the conservative record is returned UNCHANGED, but the code applies id overrides there.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:226 `fallback_id = _model_id_of(model_or_model_string)`
src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:227-241 applies `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES.get(fallback_id)` and returns a merged (non-conservative) record on the fallback path

Ticket Decision C point 4: 'path 3 (conservative fallback): no id is available, so no model-id override applies — the conservative record is returned unchanged, exactly as today'

Ticket AC: 'a test asserts the conservative-fallback path still returns the unchanged conservative record when no model id is available (the third path above), so adding the second table cannot alter it'
advisory.finding: capabilities.py's fallback path adds an unauthorized `_model_id_of`-based override branch that applies `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` onto the conservative record for an unresolved-but-id-bearing string (e.g. `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7`), contradicting Decision C path-3's stated intent that the conservative-fallback path returns the conservative record UNCHANGED because 'no id is available'.
scenarios: A `bedrock:<measured-affected-id>` STRING (not object) is passed to `capabilities_for`, which the ticket assigns to path 3 (no resolvable profile) yet the code now mutates the conservative record for.
advisory.suggested_fix: Either drop the fallback-override branch so path 3 returns `_CONSERVATIVE` unchanged as the ticket specifies, or split the `bedrock:<id>`-string defence-in-depth into its own ticket with an AC that revises the path-3 contract.
